generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portals due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in the price schedule in the website itself
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of opening
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection
The bidder shall obtain Workmen compensatory insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work
The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates
Bidders should have an independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractor s permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code
In case the dates notified above are declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Gates)S, KPC Ltd Kargal, Sagara Tq 577421.
The bidder shall upload/submit online duly, signed original copy of Form of Tender and Declaration by Bidder formats under Section 3 of bid document.

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Fabrication/Repair/Reconditioning of dam gates at any Govt. organizations/PSUs of single order value not less than Rs 9.10 lakhs. In proof of the above, a copy of work done certificate issued from the competent authority & the corresponding work order shall be furnished. (Note: The value of completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five financial years, achieved in at least two financial years, an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 18.15 Lakhs. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish Turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. (Note: Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the Financial Year in which the tenders are invited). (Note: The above documents shall be uploaded along with other documents, failing/not satisfying the above criteria the tenders are liable for rejection).In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing, fabrication, testing and commissioning of draft tube gate and other miscellaneous works at BHEP

itemList.description: Design, fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of fixed wheel type vertical lift gate consisting of skin plate, vertical and horizontal girders, wheels, stiffeners, lifting brackets, guide shoes, rubber seals with all accessories for barrage including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cutting, aligning, welding, finishing, cleaning, applying one coat of zinc rich epoxy primer and three coats of cold applied coal tar epoxy paint, seal fixing and all other ancillary operations complete as per specifications and approved drawings.

Providing ,Fabricating, transporting to site, hoisting and erecting structural steel member fabricated from rolled steel sections like channels, angles, flat, I-sections, plates, rails etc., as per drawing including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, operations such as cutting, bending, grinding, welding, etc., and providing one coat of zinc chromate red oxide primer after scrapping and cleaning the surface, etc., complete with all leads and lifts .

Supplying and fixing Bulb type teflon cladded rubber seals of dia 40mm x 100 mmx14mm for draft tube for top and sides and hot dipped G.I bolts/nuts/ washers of approved quality including cost of all materials, labour, removing existing worn out / damaged bulb type rubber seals from gates, cleaning surface, making holes in new seals, fixing new seals / bolts / nuts / washers tightly in position, scaffolding with all other ancillary operations complete-

Supplying and fixing of corner seal of dia 40mmx100 mm x 300mm length and hot dipped G.I bolts/nuts/ washers of approved quality to suit with new side seal including cleaning seal seat, valcanizing seal wherever necessary, forming holes in seal, fixing in place & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.

Supplying and fixing Flat rubber seals of size 120x14mm and hot dipped G.I bolts / nuts / washers of approved quality including cost of all materials, labour, removing existing worn out / damaged bulb type rubber seals from gates, cleaning surface, making holes in new seals, fixing new seals / bolts / nuts / washers tightly in position, scaffolding with all other ancillary operations complete-

Servicing of motor -brake drum coupling , alignment, replacement of coupling bush and damaged coupling bolts for Hoist, LT drive including replacement of defective hardwares, cost of labour, materials, machinery, tools and tackles etc.,
General servicing of LT wheel , cleaning and checking the proper alignment of wheel track to crane wheel, welding and re anchoring wherever necessary, painting, etc.,

Dismantling old damaged gate element, transportation of released gate from work spot to Left bank store yard, lifting arrangement , providing hydra crane service for lifting/lowering during errection (approx 4 days) and shifting etc. it includes cost of labour,machinery,tools and tackles required for the work
